eyebrow: Grouping rows — an intent, not a result
code:
by_vendor = trips.groupBy("VendorID")

by_vendor.show()   # FAILS -- GroupedData, not a DataFrame
caption: The PySpark equivalent of Pandas' groupby() — but incomplete on its own.
Chaining .count() turns the grouping intent into an actual DataFrame.

eyebrow: Grouping by more than one column
code:
trips.groupBy("VendorID", "passenger_count").count().show()

# every distinct (VendorID, passenger_count) pair gets its own row
caption: Each unique combination becomes its own group.

subtitle: Sums, averages, and more, per group.
